title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Bowers was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by his knee injury on Wednesday. He should be fully good to go for Week 6 and remains a must-start fantasy option moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rachaad White (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Rachaad White (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to log a full practice session to start the week on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 6 and will be primed for more work than usual if Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is unable to play on Monday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Treylon Burks (shoulder) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Treylon Burks (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: A shoulder injury left Burks limited at practice on Thursday. It doesn't look like it will leave him sidelined for Week 6, however, and he will again be primed for more work than usual if Stefon Diggs (hamstring) misses another game for Washington.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: McLaurin was able to practice on Thursday, though he remained limited due to the nagging hamstring issue that he's still managing. He should still play in Week 6 and could be startable in many leagues, especially if Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is ruled out for the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Austin Ekeler (chest) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Austin Ekeler (chest) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back was able to practice on Thursday, but he was limited due to a chest injury that he's managing. He should be available to play on Monday night still and will see more work than usual if Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) is sidelined against San Francisco.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) officially DNP Thursday
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) officially didn't practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt wasn't seen during the open portion of practice on Friday, and he was indeed sidelined due to a groin issue. It may leave him sidelined in Week 6, although he still has a couple of days to return to practice before the team begins to rule people out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thursday was San Francisco's first practice of the week, so to no surprise, they gave McCaffrey the day off as a veteran rest day. He should be back on Friday and is expected to be a full go for Monday night's game against the Washington Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk (knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Juszczyk was able to practice on Thursday and seems to be on track to make his return to the lineup in Week 6. He won't have any fantasy value himself when he's back, but his presence should improve San Francisco's offense as a whole moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Christian Kirk (calf) was officially a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Kirk was officially limited in his first practice back on Thursday. He's currently in his 21-day practice window, so the team could choose to let him sit out for another game or two before he's back in the lineup officially.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) officially did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't able to practice on Thursday. He's still dealing with a nagging issue with his ribs, but now he's also dealing with an Achilles injury of some kind. Fantasy managers should monitor his status throughout the week to make sure he will suit up and play on Monday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Bosa has been sidelined for three-straight games due to a couple of injuries that he's dealing with, and he wasn't able to practice on Thursday either. He reportedly has a chance to make his return this week, however, so it remains to be seen if he will make his return to practice on Friday or Saturday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marcus Epps (groin) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Marcus Epps (groin) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Epps was able to practice in full on Thursday after being limited by a groin issue on Wednesday. He should play in Week 6, which will make life more difficult for Bryce Young and the Panthers' offense on the other side of the ball.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Steen (shoulder) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Steen (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Steen wasn't able to practice in full on Thursday, as he's still recovering from a minor shoulder injury of some kind. Philadelphia's offensive front is already looking weaker than usual for Week 6, but it will be especially bad if Steen is also unable to play.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (hamstring) did not take part in Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wicks was not able to practice on Thursday. He's managing some kind of a hamstring issue and seems to be trending the wrong way for Week 6. Look for rookie Makai Lemon to see more work if Wicks is out this week, although neither of them should be started in this matchup against the Panthers either way.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eli Stowers (quad) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Eli Stowers (quad) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has yet to take the field for the Eagles this season due to a quad injury that left him on injured reserve. He has practiced in a limited capacity all week so far, however, which leaves him with a chance to play in Week 6. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him even if he's active, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring/toe) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring/toe) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: At first it looked like Smith was absent from Thursday's practice, but he turned out to be a limited participant. He's dealing with two separate injuries still, so it's very possible that he will be sidelined in Week 6, which would leave Dallas Goedert with more work than usual against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) limited Thursday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (ankle) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Greenard was limited for another practice on Thursday, but it still looks like he will play in Week 6. The Eagles will need his presence on the edge this week in a matchup against a Panthers' offense that has looked good to start the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Landon Dickerson (knee) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Landon Dickerson (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Philadelphia may be without one of their cornerstone offensive linemen on Sunday. Dickerson is dealing with a knee issue of some kind right now and is currently on the injury report heading into Week 6 because of it. Their offensive front will be much weaker than usual if they lose him on top of everyone else they have been losing lately.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Grant Calcaterra (back) considered limited Thursday
items.desc: Grant Calcaterra (back) was considered limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Calcaterra was limited for another practice on Thursday. He may be sidelined in Week 6 due to his back injury, but that has yet to be determined officially.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Hollywood Brown (ankle) limited Thursday
items.desc: Hollywood Brown (ankle) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Brown was again limited by an ankle injury at practice on Thursday. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, regardless of whether or not he's healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Shipley (foot) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Will Shipley (foot) officially did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Shipley was a non-participant at practice on Thursday after recently suffering a major foot injury. He will almost certainly be sidelined in Week 6, leaving Dameon Pierce as the team's top back ahead of a matchup against the Panthers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Shough (hand) logs another full practice Thursday
items.desc: Tyler Shough (hand) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The young quarterback's hand injury isn't serious and hasn't affected his participation at practice all week thus far. He should play and will be looking to bounce back on Sunday after a disappointing performance in Week 5.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alvin Kamara (back) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Alvin Kamara (back) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kamara was able to practice in a limited fashion again on Thursday, though he's still dealing with a nagging back issue. He should play through it in Week 6 but doesn't project to be the bellcow back for the team for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Olave (illness) misses practice again Thursday
items.desc: Chris Olave (illness) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Olave remained sidelined for another practice session on Thursday as he continues to recover from some kind of an illness. It's hard to imagine this leaving him sidelined in Week 6, although we won't know his official game status until sometime after practice on Friday. Fantasy managers should be attentive to all updates about his health.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darnell Mooney (neck) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Darnell Mooney (neck) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday, despite being limited by a neck issue on Wednesday. He should play in Week 6 but will continue to be irrelevant from a fantasy perspective moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Theo Johnson (neck) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Theo Johnson (neck) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Johnson was able to practice in a limited capacity again on Thursday. It looks like he will be available to play in Week 6, but even if he is, fantasy managers shouldn't be expecting him to score many points against the Saints this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Abdul Carter (calf) unable to practice Thursday
items.desc: Abdul Carter (calf) was unable to practice for the Giants on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like the Giants may be without Carter on Sunday, as he has been sidelined for two-straight practices to start the week. Their defensive front will be much weaker if he's unable to suit up.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Jermaine Eluemunor (calf) was absent from New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, the veteran wasn't able to practice again on Thursday as he continues to recover from a calf injury. The Giants will be in trouble this week if he and Andrew Thomas (groin) are sidelined, which would leave them without both of their starting tackles against the Saints.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (groin) missed New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thomas was not able to practice on Thursday and remained sidelined due to his groin injury. His participation at Friday's practice will be a significant indication of whether or not he will be available to play in Week 6.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tylan Wallace (knee) limited Thursday
items.desc: Tylan Wallace (knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Wallace was a limited participant for another practice on Thursday. He's still rehabbing a knee issue of some kind, but he may be available to play in Week 6, although he remains off of the fantasy radar either way.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Dylan Sampson (knee) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Sampson wasn't able to practice on Wednesday due to a knee issue of some kind, but he was back and able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday. He may play in Week 6, and if that's the case, he would likely be an involved member of the committee that would be needed to replace Quinshon Judkins (ankle) if he's unable to play against the Ravens.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Elgton Jenkins (knee) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Elgton Jenkins (knee) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran lineman was able to log a full practice session on Thursday, meaning his knee injury shouldn't affect his availability for Week 6. His presence will offer nice consistency for the Browns and their offensive front on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Teven Jenkins (back) was absent from Cleveland's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jenkins has yet to play in a game for the Browns this year. He's dealing with a lingering back issue of some kind, and the timetable for his recovery remains uncertain at this point. Cleveland's offensive front will continue to carry on without him for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tytus Howard (knee) back at practice Thursday
items.desc: Tytus Howard (knee) was back at Cleveland's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Howard seems to be recovering well from his knee issue, as he was able to return to practice as a limited participant on Thursday. Cleveland's offensive line will benefit greatly if he's available to suit up and play this weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. (concussion) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: KC Concepcion Jr. (concussion) was limited at Cleveland's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has been limited at both of Cleveland's practices to start the week, meaning that he has not yet fully cleared the NFL's concussion protocols. It looks like he's trending toward playing in Week 6, however, but fantasy managers still shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Denzel Boston (foot) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Denzel Boston (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday due to a nagging foot injury that he's dealing with. It looks like he will be available to play through it in Week 6, however, and fantasy managers should feel comfortable starting him if he doesn't carry an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (rest/toe/ankle) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Stanley was able to log a full practice session on Thursday. He's dealing with a couple of different issues right now, but they aren't serious and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 6. His presence will be important for the Ravens in their divisional matchup against Cleveland on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was officially a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wasn't able to practice on Thursday after being limited by a groin injury on Wednesday. He may very well still play in Week 6, but Baltimore's offensive front will be weaker than usual if he's ruled out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Roger Rosengarten (knee) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Roger Rosengarten (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Rosengarten popped up on Baltimore's injury report on Wednesday due to a knee issue, but he was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday and should be good to go for Week 6. Baltimore has several linemen on the injury report still, however, so it's uncertain if they will be at full strength this week or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was able to log a full practice session on Thursday, which was expected. He seems to be primed to make his return to the lineup in the very near future, and we should know what his status is for Week 6 sometime within the next 24 hours or so.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cam Jurgens (concussion) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Cam Jurgens (concussion) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Jurgens is uncertain to make his debut for the Ravens in Week 6, as he still hasn't cleared the NFL's concussion protocols and remained limited at practice on Thursday. Baltimore's offensive front will see a nice boost whenever he's available to make his debut for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf) full participant Thursday
items.desc: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring/calf) was a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran cornerback was upgraded to a full participant at Thursday's practice after being limited by a pair of injuries on Wednesday. He should play in Week 6 in a favorable matchup against the Browns.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (toe) limited at practice Thursday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (toe) was a limited participant at Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Flowers is a new addition to Baltimore's injury report. He was limited at practice on Thursday after being a full participant on Wednesday, but this may just be a load management move on the part of the team. For now, fantasy managers should expect him to play in Week 6, although his projected output is likely to be lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) trending towards being sidelined again.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jamel Dean (ankle) limited Thursday
items.desc: Jamel Dean (ankle) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dean was a limited participant for yet another practice on Thursday as he continues to battle with a nagging ankle issue. He will have a good chance to play in Week 6 still, but it remains to be seen whether or not he will be well enough to play in time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) limited participant Thursday
items.desc: DeShon Elliott (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Elliot was limited for another practice on Thursday as he continues to work his way back from a knee issue. Friday's injury report should give us a good idea of whether or not he will play in Week 6.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Riley Moss (ribs) active on Thursday night
items.desc: Riley Moss (ribs) is active for the Broncos on Thursday night against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Moss was initially questionable for the contest, but he will play and reinforce the Broncos secondary. He will try to step up in Pat Surtain's absence, but gets a tough assignment in JSN and company.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: George Holani active for Thursday Night Football
items.desc: George Holani is active for Seattle's Thursday Night Football game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Holani was able to get back from a rib injury after missing the past several weeks. He will split the backfield workload with Emanuel Wilson, but Wilson is the better fantasy option, with Holani being primarily a third down back with little upside.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) will not return in Week 6
items.desc: Tank Dell (knee) will not play in Sunday's matchup against the Jaguars.
items.impact: There was some thought that Dell would finally make his long-awaited return for the Texans on Sunday. Instead, even after practicing in full on Wednesday, he will remain behind as the team travels to London. Dell seems likely to play in Week 7 against the Giants.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) out for Week 6
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) will not play against the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: As expected, Montgomery will not play in Sunday's divisional matchup in London. The veteran back has not practiced this week due to a groin injury and will cede the lead RB role to Woody Marks.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) to miss Week 6
items.desc: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not play in Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Pitre will remain behind as the Texans travel to London to face the division-rival Jaguars. Kamari Ramsey is likely to see an uptick in snaps.
